summary.text: Larry Zikmund is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 14 who assumed office in January 2021 after serving in the state House from 2015 to 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A U.S. Air Force veteran, he has worked as an electrician, plumber, carpenter and construction worker.

paragraphs.text: Larry Zikmund served in the U.S. Air Force, and his career experience includes working as an electrician, plumber, carpenter, and construction worker.
Zikmund represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 14 from 2015 to 2021 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 12, 2021, succeeding Deb Soholt.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the Senate Appropriations Committee and chairs the Senate Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee.
